<!-- dozu-tracking:start -->
## Work tracking
Use the live **status:**, **priority:** and **complexity:** labels above; **Assignees** identifies the owner. These labels are separate from the task/ticket type.

**Planning complexity:** L - Python and native ML dependency/model packaging across operating systems.
Complexity is a provisional scope/uncertainty estimate, not a delivery-time commitment. XL work must be split into executable subtasks before starting.
**Planning priority:** P0 - Architecture/foundation work that unblocks the implementation path.
<!-- dozu-tracking:end -->

<!-- dozu-resource-contract-2026-11-14:start -->
## Accepted desktop resource contract — 2026-11-14

Authority: the user explicitly accepted the proposed larger initial-release hardware/resource targets in the #8 chat. This supersedes earlier 4 GB/dual-core/HDD, 250 MB installer, 750 MB installed, 700 MB/1 GB normal-memory, cold UI 10/5 s and backend-ready 8/4 s requirements wherever they appear below or in historical scope notes. OS versions, CPU architecture matrix, installer formats, feature/data/security/lifecycle obligations and deferred capabilities are unchanged. Requirements approval is not benchmark or release acceptance.

| Hardware | Minimum | Recommended |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU | 64-bit, 4 physical cores | 6–8 cores |
| System RAM | 8 GB | 16 GB |
| Storage | SSD; 10 GB free before installation | SSD; 20 GB free |
| Graphics | Integrated graphics; CPU inference | Dedicated GPU optional |
| Display | 1366 × 768 | 1920 × 1080 |

| Initial-release whole-application target | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Installer download | ≤ 1.5 GB |
| Installed application, all bundled runtimes/model/resources included | ≤ 3 GB |
| Normal combined app memory | ≤ 2 GB RAM |
| Peak during one ingestion/embedding job | ≤ 3 GB RAM |
| Interactive UI after cold launch | ≤ 15 s |
| Complete local backend/model readiness | ≤ 30 s |

Memory includes Electron, Next, Express, PostgreSQL, Redis and running embedding/conversion workers. The existing warm-UI targets were not changed: ≤5 s on minimum and ≤3 s on recommended hardware. Imported documents/media, growing databases and user backups require additional disk. Installation/update/restore preflight must calculate actual staging and data requirements rather than assuming the initial free-space allowance covers unlimited data.

Keep the existing pinned multilingual CPU model for the initial integration path; smaller/quantized runtime optimization may follow later. ONNX is an evaluation candidate, not a release prerequisite or an approved model substitution. Preserve real semantic PDF/YouTube transcript references, the 384-dimensional API contract, English/Vietnamese behavior, local authority and genuine provider integrations. No STT, SMTP, payment execution or pgvector is restored by this amendment; Redis and PostgreSQL remain retained.

Minimum-hardware acceptance uses one active user with one ingestion job at a time; concurrent LAN hosting and large-library capacity require separate measured tests. Validate the complete application on actual 8 GB/four-core SSD hardware and every required native OS/architecture before advertising support. Component proof, larger allowances and approval do not pass installer, full-stack memory/startup, native dependency, file-path/ownership or lifecycle ACs.

Canonical requirements and evidence rules: [platform-support.md](https://github.com/Do-Zu/dozu/blob/dev/planning/platform-support.md). Prior measurements and closed issue histories remain historical evidence; no completed/cancelled issue is reopened or counted as release proof by this change.
<!-- dozu-resource-contract-2026-11-14:end -->

## Outcome
Package the current text-embedding service for PDF/YouTube reference retrieval as a managed local process with its full CPU-capable runtime/model resources.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Lock complete Python dependencies and package native libraries per target OS/architecture; no user pip/Python setup.
- [ ] Bundle pinned model/tokenizer/config resources and preserve the existing 384-dimensional vector contract.
- [ ] Load baseline resources from verified local paths without Hub fallback downloads blocking local startup.
- [ ] Verify text/PDF/existing-transcript-text contracts (speech-to-text is deferred) and CPU operation; optional acceleration must not require manual setup.
- [ ] Expose loopback readiness/shutdown and route user files through authenticated local paths or URLs.

## Architecture constraints
The complete existing Next.js UI and Express backend run locally with a local database/files. Desktop and local browser use the same localhost backend. Real third-party integrations may use the internet; preserve them wherever feasible. No central Dozu backend, cloud database, synchronization, shared publisher secrets in installers, or simulated replacements. All existing pages remain in scope; explicit v1 capability deferrals in the 2026-11-11 amendment below apply.

<!-- dozu-roadmap:PYTHON -->

Phase: 1 Foundation | Priority: P0

Parent roadmap: https://github.com/Do-Zu/dozu/issues/1

## Dependencies
- #5 - [Task] Import current frontend/backend/embedding sources with provenance
- #38 - [Task] Assemble verified per-platform runtimes, binaries and licenses
- #34 - [Task] Define app-owned local data paths and ownership manifest

<!-- dozu-v1-scope-2026-11-11:start -->
## User-approved v1 scope amendment — 2026-11-11

- Remove local speech-to-text from this version: no whisper.cpp server, tiny speech model, speech startup/readiness gate or speech-only assets. Retain independent media playback and genuine existing YouTube transcript text retrieval. Preserve source/page inventory; no fake transcript or new cloud STT fallback.
- Keep PostgreSQL; **defer pgvector**. A private relational cluster, reviewed migrations/seeds, persistence and data-safe upgrades remain required. Current vector(384), `<=>` and HNSW consumers need explicit reviewed adaptation; do not blindly run vector-dependent migrations, discard data or replace PostgreSQL.
- The measured 479.729 MB MiniLM snapshot is a separate **text-embedding model**, used by retained PDF/YouTube reference search and ingestion. The user's condition for dropping its experiment is not met: keep smaller-runtime/quantization proof scoped to these consumers. No working smaller runtime or pgvector-free ranking implementation is claimed.
- Ordinary PostgreSQL array/JSONB vector storage plus bounded application-side cosine ranking is an evaluation candidate only. Prove owner/topic filtering, 384-value shape, ranking/topK/ties, persistence/migration, quality and realistic scale/resource budgets before adopting it. Semantic reference retrieval has not been deferred by this decision.
- Exclude FFmpeg only when its sole consumer is deferred speech-to-text; separately prove any retained non-STT need. Keep required document/URL/PDF/editor/media/font/browser resources. OS/CPU/installers, 250 MB installer/750 MB installed and memory/startup targets remain unchanged. Payments remain deferred under #41; classrooms remain LAN.

Source trace: `PdfFileEmbeddingStrategy.ts`, `YoutubeEmbeddingStrategy.ts`, `BaseEmbeddingStrategy.queryTopSimilarity()`, `inputSet.service.ts`, UI topic `components/reference/Reference.tsx`, and separate `features/whisper/api/whisper.service.ts`. Full record: local `planning/v1-scope-2026-11-11.md`. Earlier audits/measurements are historical evidence. Planning updates are not implemented feature removal or passing acceptance.
<!-- dozu-v1-scope-2026-11-11:end -->

<!-- dozu-embedding-component-ac-review-2026-11-14:start -->
## AC review after accepted resource revision — 2026-11-14

The original five release ACs above remain open. The resource amendment removes the old size-budget objection to the default pinned CPU baseline and defers ONNX optimization; it does not complete native packaging or final installation acceptance. The following **Windows developer-host component checks** are verified by [commit 66db470 and its evidence](https://github.com/Do-Zu/dozu/blob/66db470989b7f66280f3d1d4e4ba6ce82db834e0/planning/embedding-runtime/README.md), not full supported-platform release claims:

- [x] Exact 45-package baseline and 37-package ONNX candidate Windows CPython 3.13 wheel/hash closures, official artifact provenance and license/native inventories recorded.
- [x] Model/tokenizer/config files pinned to revision 86741b4e3f5cb7765a600d3a3d55a0f6a6cb443d; baseline CPU vectors have 384 finite normalized values.
- [x] Real packaged startup from local resources with fresh process caches and non-loopback process-level network denial; no Hub fallback or runtime/model download attempt observed.
- [x] Actual text, mixed/empty batch, PDF page and supplied transcript-text/time-reference HTTP contracts exercised: 28 checks per package, including security failures.
- [x] Missing token/model and corrupt resources exit nonzero; authenticated graceful shutdown exits 0: three failure cases per package.
- [x] Authenticated loopback PDF URLs and canonical test-root boundaries exercised in Unicode/space paths; package integrity/file sets unchanged after tests.
- [x] Baseline component measured at 1,249,334,226 installed bytes and 658,610,092 ZIP bytes, below the revised 3 GB/1.5 GB allowances **for the component alone**. This is not full-app installer/installed acceptance.
- [ ] Complete native dependency closure and clean supported OS/CPU proof: host Microsoft C++ runtime DLLs remain observed; #38/#23.
- [ ] Final owned user paths, permissions/read-only installation and actual API/supervisor integration: #34/#18/#28.
- [ ] Whole-app 8 GB/four-core SSD acceptance, combined 2 GB normal/3 GB peak RAM, 15 s UI/30 s full readiness, genuine installer/installed footprint and retained full workflows: #22/#23/#21/#29 and native owners.

No original release AC, issue state/owner or dependency link is changed by this component checklist. ONNX optimization/representation equivalence is deferred, while required baseline semantic behavior and English/Vietnamese workflow evidence remain release obligations. [Current cross-issue AC review](https://github.com/Do-Zu/dozu/blob/dev/planning/resource-amendment-2026-11-14/acceptance-review.md).
<!-- dozu-embedding-component-ac-review-2026-11-14:end -->
